H1.claim: Gradient boosting (HGB) catches a larger share of anomalies per house than the timer rule at the same false-alert rate (1 per appliance-month)

H2.claim: Gradient boosting (HGB) raises its alert earlier than the timer rule on anomalies both catch

H3.claim: Adding features relative to the appliance's own history raises per-house recall over raw behaviour only

H4.claim: Sensor-stuck events show lower power variation while 'running' than real stuck-on compressors

H5.claim: Cold appliances run a larger share of the time in summer than in winter
